subtitle: the roughest initial data the equation can handle
summary: The KdV equation, a classic model of water waves, still makes reliable predictions when the starting wave is extremely rough.
problem: Extending the KdV flow from Schwartz space to the critical low-regularity space H^{-1} was a longstanding open problem. This Annals of Mathematics
paper resolved it by introducing the method of commuting flows—a breakthrough that generalized to many other integrable systems and led to an invited lecture at ICM 2026.
We use LEAP to formalize the paper's main result end-to-end.
title: KdV is well-posed in H⁻¹
